definitions.explanation: A male parent. A more formal or objective term than {父|ちち} or お{父|とう}さん.

examples.japanese: {父親|ちちおや}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: As a father, I worry about my children's future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{父親|ちちおや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似|に}て→似る：01159_niru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{父親|ちちおや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I grew up watching my father's back (learning from his example).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{父親|ちちおや}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He is the father of two children.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {父親|ちちおや}: Formal, objective term for 'father' used when discussing fathers in general or describing family relationships
- ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧: Humble term used to refer to one's own father when speaking to others
- ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧: Polite/familiar term used to address one's father or refer to someone else's father
- ⟦パパ→パパ：01788_papa⟧: Casual, childish term for 'daddy'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {父親|ちちおや}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as a father)
- {父親|ちちおや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a father)
- {父親|ちちおや}⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧ (fatherly)
